ask: Is it fine that a second phone now skips the welcome once the server says it was already seen?
problem: Someone who starts an organization and then signs in on a second phone sees the welcome again. The nightly test for this got stuck on that welcome.
found: No recent change caused it. A new phone waits 4 seconds to hear if the person was already welcomed. On the busy test machine the answer came late and was ignored. The other three failures have other causes.
changed: If the yes comes late, the welcome is replaced by My Work, as long as the person has not moved on. A failed question is now asked again a few times.
why: This fixes the real cause instead of setting the test aside. Slow networks hit it too. NAV-023, STUDY-030 and SETUP-016 fail for other reasons and need their own manager.
touches: The first sign-in on any new phone, for people already welcomed on another phone.

pictures.label: Before: the second phone stays on the welcome

linear.comment: Finding: product race, not a flaky test. A device new to an account asks the server whether it was already welcomed and routes after 4 s; under nightly load the answer came late and a late yes was ignored, so the second device stayed on Welcome. A read sent before the sign-in was attached also counted as no. Fix: the read retries, and a late yes moves an untouched welcome to the home. Nothing merged since the last green nightly caused it (only the ETEN deck changed). NAV-023 (LAN-251), STUDY-030 (LAN-253) and SETUP-016 (LAN-254) fail differently and are not covered. PR: https://github.com/genesis-ai-dev/langquest-next/pull/416
